<LinearLayout width="@data{width}" height="match_content" orientation="vertical" userId="node_inventory_report_card" cornerRadius="6np" backgroundColor="#FFFFFF">
  <FastTextView userId="node_inventory_report_title" width="match_parent" height="match_content" text="@toStr{@data{data.cardData.title}}" textSize="16np" isBold="true" textColor="#35404B" marginLeft="12np" marginRight="12np" marginTop="8np" marginBottom="8np" maxLines="2" />
  <FastTextView userId="node_inventory_report_summary" width="match_parent" height="match_content" text="@toStr{@data{data.cardData.summary}}" textSize="12np" textColor="#6F809A" marginLeft="12np" marginRight="12np" marginTop="8np" marginBottom="8np" maxLines="3" />
  <LinearLayout width="match_parent" height="480np" userId="node_inventory_report_image" onTap="@dtPreviewImage{@toStr{@data{data.cardData.reportImage}},@dtArrayAppend{null,@toStr{@data{data.cardData.reportImage}}}}">
    <ImageView width="match_parent" height="480np" imageUrl="@toStr{@data{data.cardData.reportImage}}" scaleType="fitCenter" />
  </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>
